scope: Read-only audit of experimental design, pilot power and seed/temporal inference in E1 sections4.1 and4.3; no data, fits, simulations or test evaluations.

findings.finding: Detecting a5percent gain against zero is distinct from demonstrating a gain greater than the5percent practical threshold.
findings.correction: Retain guide bilateral approximation for effect-against-zero; for threshold superiority specify null boundary, planning alternative and their distance.

findings.finding: Seed-based R estimates training variability conditional on a fixed market calendar, not temporal sample size or new markets.
findings.correction: Label repetition unit and scope of power and confidence intervals.

findings.finding: Hyperparameter selection using all2024 cannot make the same2024 errors an independent external assessment.
findings.correction: Label2024 as selection validation or require temporally nested selection for outer2024 claims; keep final test untouched.

findings.finding: Normal approximate power from five pilot seeds has uncertain variance; nonrejection of normality is not confirmation.
findings.correction: Treat formula as planning approximation; justify final design, uncertainty and relevant alternative.

findings.finding: Per-contrast alpha0.05 does not automatically control an expanded family.
findings.correction: Preregister comparisons across models/configurations and account for multiplicity in planning.

findings.finding: Guide minimum six rank-test runs is not a power guarantee and is insufficient for first Holm rejection across three exact bilateral Wilcoxon comparisons.
findings.correction: Preserve minimum but dimension above it according to real design; do not replace power with attainable-p-value arithmetic.

findings.finding: Pilot reuse and adaptive sample size can undermine confirmatory interpretation if unplanned.
findings.correction: Register calibration-only or justified reuse, sample-size reestimation rule and stopping criteria.

findings.finding: Same numerical seed does not create equivalent initialization or random trajectories across architectures.
findings.correction: Use common replicate identifiers and component-specific seeds without promising common-random-number variance reduction.

findings.finding: Current literature selection of three DL basics remains open.
findings.correction: Call the three existing family fact sheets candidates and block pilot configuration until selection closes.

findings.finding: Persistence RMSE is constant across seeds but not a known population constant across temporal resamples.
findings.correction: For temporal relative-gain inference resample paired dates and recompute both RMSEs and denominator.

findings.finding: Historical pilot draft deliberately retains prior nulls and fold hash.
findings.correction: Preserve it and distinguish a current preparation version from any frozen or executed protocol.

findings.finding: Internal stopping cuts and refit cadence remain open and are not implied by fold indices.
findings.correction: Record them as execution-blocking choices without inventing dates or training settings.

guide_normal_approximation: ceil((z_(1-alpha/2)+z_(1-beta))^2 sigma_d^2/delta^2) detects an effect delta against0, conditional on its assumptions
practical_threshold_approximation: For preregistered one-sided H0:mu_G<=delta0, choose g_alt>delta0 and use denominator(g_alt-delta0)^2, adjusted planning alpha and appropriate variance.
conclusion: Documentary corrections can close definitions, status and limitations; numeric pilot R/MDE, architecture configurations, software/hardware and empirical results cannot be supplied without E2 execution.
